debt.text: Bronin says he would work to ensure Social Security remains available to current recipients and future retirees who pay into it.
debt.quote: As a Member of Congress, I’ll work to ensure that Social Security is there for everyone who’s receiving it now, and for everyone who’s paying into it now and depending on it in the future.

housing.text: Bronin supports a larger federal role in affordable housing development and updating federal housing finance programs.
housing.quote: Go back and look at the GI Bill, throughout much of the 20th century, the federal government was a huge part of creating housing opportunity, and in more recent decades, it's done less and less,” Bronin said.

safety.text: He supports both violence-prevention programs and policing and enforcement measures.
safety.quote: I’ve also seen that smart prevention, effective policing, and common-sense gun laws can actually make a difference.

immigration.text: He supports legal immigration pathways, citizenship for DACA recipients, and due-process protections while proposing to abolish ICE.
immigration.quote: Go back on offense to push for the comprehensive immigration reform that Americans know we need: secure borders, fair and timely asylum processing, citizenship for DACA recipients, legal pathways that encourage more legal immigration, and enforcement that respects the due process of law and basic human dignity.

guns.text: Bronin says he would support universal background checks, an assault weapons ban, safe storage laws and red-flag laws.
guns.quote: I’ll fight for common-sense gun laws like universal background checks, an assault weapons ban, safe storage laws, red-flag laws, firearms education, accountability for repeat violent offenders, and serious consequences for gun dealers and gun manufacturers who break the law.

abortion.text: Bronin says Congress should pass nationwide federal protections for abortion access.
abortion.quote: Reproductive freedom is a basic human right. Congress must pass federal protections for abortion access nationwide.

cannabis.text: As Hartford mayor, he publicly supported ending marijuana prohibition and regulating it.
cannabis.quote: Ending the prohibition on marijuana will allow for regulation bringing public health and public safety standards.

health.text: Bronin supports strengthening Medicare and Medicaid and pursuing universal health care.
health.quote: We need to protect and strengthen Medicare and Medicaid, negotiate down the price of prescription drugs, and push for universal, affordable healthcare.

energy.text: He supports rapidly scaling clean-energy development and public investment in the energy transition.
energy.quote: We need to build quickly and at scale. That means streamlining red tape that makes it too hard and costly to build. It means using smart public investments to accelerate the transition.

tax.text: She says government should spend less and advocates reducing taxes on earned income and property.
tax.quote: We must spend less. We also must change our tax structure to stop punishing wage earners for working more and more hours for less and less return.

debt.text: She identifies the national debt as the country’s greatest challenge and supports cutting improper spending.
debt.quote: The greatest challenge to the United States over the next decade is our unsustainable national debt.

housing.text: She has proposed a Hartford pilot to build affordable homeownership opportunities on underused properties, with possible expansion if successful.
housing.quote: Chai also has plans for a pilot program in Hartford that would construct affordable home ownership opportunities on underutilized properties.

schools.text: She says parents should be able to choose public schooling or home education for their children.
schools.quote: Parents have every right to determine what their children are learning, whether it be through public schools or home education.

safety.text: She says government should invest in preventing mental illness and addiction.
safety.quote: Because we know the causes, we must invest in prevention.

immigration.text: She supports lawful immigration enforcement and secure borders while also calling for due process and humane treatment.
immigration.quote: I support lawful immigration enforcement, secure borders, and cooperation among federal, state, and local authorities when a person is already in government custody.

housing.text: She called for ramping up energy-efficient housing construction and changing zoning to build affordable housing.
housing.quote: We need to ramp up construction of energy-efficient housing and make it affordable to families.
